name: First Solar Louisiana
old_description: First Solar’s roots run deep in American soil. Born in the Midwest, headquartered in the Southwest, and shipped worldwide, First Solar is an American success story. Driven by a passion for innovation and powered by American ingenuity, First Solar has consistently invested in American manufacturing and American jobs. Today, it is the only US-headquartered company among the world’s largest module producers.
about:
First Solar operates a manufacturing facility in New Iberia, Louisiana, part of a company born in the Midwest and now headquartered in the Southwest. The facility produces photovoltaic modules using the company's proprietary cadmium telluride (CdTe) thin-film technology.

The plant manufactures Series 6 and Series 7 solar modules, along with mounting components, wiring harnesses, and preformed line products. Its differentiated semiconductor process yields modules with a warranted annual degradation rate of 0.3 percent and what the company calls the industry's only cell-cracking warranty. The SpeedSlot mounting feature is designed to reduce installation time and hardware costs. Recycling solutions and post-sales support round out the offering.

The modules serve utility-scale, commercial, and residential solar projects worldwide. First Solar positions itself as the only U.S.-headquartered company among the world's largest module producers, shipping to the Americas, Europe, the Middle East, Africa, India, and Asia-Pacific.

The company emphasizes its "Responsible Solar" framework, citing the lowest carbon footprint, water footprint, and energy payback time in the industry. Its thin-film technology was developed through decades of research and capital investment, aiming to deliver more lifetime energy per nameplate watt than conventional crystalline-silicon panels.
